boundary: This is a software reference architecture and bit-count model. No FPGA synthesis, timing closure, photonic implementation, radiation result, or physical-device demonstration is claimed.

mask240_validator.representation: one Python integer bit mask per frame or orbit

rook_double_crossbar.connection_rule: cross-bank cells share a row or column

storage_model.boundary: The 5x figure assumes the D8 generators are fixed in the design and excludes metadata, transporter, and error-detection storage.

theorem: A single executable reference model composes the literal D8 orbit scheduler, 240-bit exact-cover validator, rank-three 36-lane spread mixer, and 18-lane rook-double crossbar. The frozen schedule expands from twelve orbit descriptors to sixty frames and covers all 240 edges exactly once.
